title: Gen-2 shared definitions
description: Identifiers, hashes, timestamps and enumerations shared by every gen-2 schema. Prefix-typed IDs make cross-wiring (an operation ID where an invocation ID belongs) a validation error instead of a silent join.

sha256.description: Content hash: 'sha256:' + 64 lowercase hex digits. For JSON documents the hash is taken over the canonical form declared in gen2/store/README.md (open question: RFC 8785 JCS vs a stdlib-reproducible subset).

timestamp.description: UTC instant, RFC 3339 with a literal Z. A pattern rather than `format` so it is always enforced.

topic_id.description: '<fleet_id>:<topic slug>'. Fleet-prefixed so Fleet A/B topics with similar names are never merged (design review §4).

local_id.description: An identifier stable within one topic (obligation, facet, criterion, rule, entry).

revision.description: A document revision number; revisions start at 1.

state_revision.description: The router's optimistic-concurrency counter for a topic; starts at 0.

artifact_ref.description: An immutable, content-addressed artifact staged by trusted station code in the protected spool. Location derives from the hash; agents never choose a destination path (design review §5).

observed_count.description: A count that may be unobserved. Unknown is a distinct state with a reason, never 0 (invariant RG-U; flow §4.3).

access_tier.description: Ordered: bibliographic < abstract < full_text < reproduced. Different checks, not interchangeable 'verified' flags (flow S4 step 8; design review §8).

candidate_unit.description: The four units evidence accounting keeps distinct (flow S4 step 2; adjudication (b)7).

coverage_state.description: Gateway coverage vocabulary with its narrow meanings (gateway/docs/STATION-CONTRACT.md §2), plus 'unknown' for lost telemetry — design review §9: missing observations become acknowledged unknowns, never ignored.

invocation_kind.description: Every execution kind shares one lifecycle (BOUNDARIES.md Station supervisor; invariant RG-2). Decision-provider calls are made inside an invocation, not as a kind of their own.

invocation_state.description: Allowed transitions are listed in docs/gen2/INVARIANTS.md L-1 and enforced by the invocations trigger in gen2/store/schema.sql.

completion_outcome.description: Distinct recorded outcomes (flow S7). A resource stop is never relabeled as saturation.

decision_class.description: Decision classes named in the flow doc. Initial rollout exercises only screening (shadow) and method_selection (advisory) — flow §5.

authority_level.description: shadow: logged, never shown or acted on. advisory: a recommendation a person or the primary disposes of. qualified: the router's policy may commit a reversible action; requires a qualification reference for this exact DecisionSpec (flow §2).

sink.description: Physical publication sinks, named as such — never 'GraphRAG' (flow S8 item 2).
